title: orbitopt optimization result (IR)
description: Dict form of orbitopt.optimization.OptimizationResult (E14-01, ADR optimization-0001): the answer to the problem named by problem_digest. The four statuses are independent booleans that default to false and are never derived from each other; evidence lists what supports them.

x.description: Best point, by variable name, in each variable's unit.

objective_values.description: By objective name, in each objective's unit and declared sense.

constraint_residuals.description: Canonical residuals by constraint name: g <= 0 for inequalities, h = 0 for equalities.

wall_time_s.description: Wall-clock seconds of the solve. Volatile: result_digest leaves it out, as it leaves out every key named wall_s, wall_time_s or latency_s at any depth (orbitopt.optimization.VOLATILE_KEYS).

front.description: Non-dominated feasible points of a multi-objective solve; empty otherwise.

provenance.description: How the result was obtained; part of the result digest.

cache_key.description: Problem digest the serving cache stored the result under; null for a fresh solve.

producer.description: What produced the evidence: a solver id, a tool id or a method.

problem_digest.description: The problem the evidence was produced for.
